answer: Physical Presence Beacon Registry: each identity must periodically transmit a beacon whose timing triangulates to a distinct physical location. Colluding operators on one machine can fake timing but not occupy two locations, since a single device can't appear on both an island and a mainland at once. Attacker cost: one real, separately sited device per identity, plus upkeep, so mass fabrication collapses into hardware and logistics expense. The meadow of cheap fake accounts becomes a forge of costly real ones.
